data.title: Molecular logic of mTORC1 signalling as a metabolic rheostat
data.authors: Valvezan AJ; Manning BD et al.

evidence.label: Review — secondary literature, not a new result
evidence.note: this describes the kind of study, not its quality

data.finding: Review framing mTORC1 as a metabolic rheostat coupling growth signals to metabolism.
data.abstract_excerpt: The protein kinase complex mechanistic target of rapamycin complex 1 (mTORC1) serves as a key conduit between growth signals and the metabolic processes underlying cell growth. The activation state of mTORC1 is controlled by intracellular nutrients and energy, as well as exogenous hormones and growth factors, thereby integrating local and systemic growth signals. Here we discuss the molecular logic of the mTORC1 signalling network and its importance in coupling growth signals to the control of cellular metabolism.

extracted_findings.effect: Frames mTORC1 as a metabolic rheostat coupling growth signals to cellular metabolism
